findings.text: The second send reuses stillHere computed before its await, leaking replies across accounts. Repro: a Node VM ran the actual submit callback, held the second send, switched A/conv5/thread9 to B/conv6/thread11, then resolved it as stale (null); B's threadMsgs contained A's reply. Capture sessionGeneration and recheck it plus the active conversation/thread after every await. An in-memory guard reduced foreign messages from 1 to 0.

Draft ownership remains unsafe across tabs: saveDraft overwrites the shared owner marker, while loadDraft reads unscoped conversation keys without checking ownership. Repro: two Node VM instances sharing localStorage; A claims account 1, B claims 2, A saves ALICE_SYNTHETIC_DRAFT, then B.loadDraft(5) returns ALICE_SYNTHETIC_DRAFT. Namespace drafts by actor and validate ownership on every read/write; add a two-tab regression.

U11 NOT ADDRESSED for matches beyond the first page: when the newest 200 messages fail from:/date filters, this return hides pagination despite olderBefore being set. Repro: Node VM invoked resultsHtml with empty groups, listing=true and olderBefore=201; output said 'Nothing in #general matches these filters' and paginationVisible=false. Keep Show older available on empty filtered pages, or fetch onward until a match or the end.
